zh: 週一盤前，最近一個完整交易日仍是上週五：標普 500 收 7,561.67 點、跌 0.40%；那斯達克收 25,136.27 點、跌 0.91%；道瓊收 52,347.55 點、逆勢漲 0.10%；羅素 2000 收 2,790.49 點、跌 0.31%。恐慌指數 VIX 升 3.7% 到 19.39。三大指數整週都收紅，但週五的分歧很清楚：科技與 AI 相關股在賣，道瓊成分股比較穩。今天沒有新的收盤數字可看，重點移到盤前消息與下午的 Fed 官員談話。
en: Before Monday's open the latest full session is still last Friday: the S&P 500 closed at 7,561.67 (-0.40%), the Nasdaq at 25,136.27 (-0.91%), the Dow at 52,347.55 (+0.10%) and the Russell 2000 at 2,790.49 (-0.31%). The VIX rose 3.7% to 19.39. All three major indexes rose on the week, but Friday split clearly: technology and AI-linked names were sold while Dow components held up. There is no new close to read today, so attention shifts to premarket news and Fed speakers this afternoon.

那斯達克 100 ETF，科技賣壓較重
道瓊 ETF，週五逆勢 +0.10%

zh: Nvidia 在 11 月 12 日的 8-K 文件中宣布，黃仁勳立即辭去總裁、執行長與董事職務，財務長 Colette Kress 兼任代理執行長，董事會正在找新的執行長，並首度設立董事長，由 Harvey Jones 擔任。CNBC 說 Nvidia 一週跌約 13%，但三大指數整週是 8 月以來最好的一週，資金轉去 Apple、AMD、Broadcom；一位資深人士形容「Nvidia 的故事現在只屬於它自己」。關於黃仁勳辭職前的調查報導，目前都是未證實的指稱，我只引用公司文件上的事實。
en: In its November 12 Form 8-K Nvidia said Jensen Huang stepped down immediately as president, CEO and director; CFO Colette Kress is interim CEO, the board is searching for a permanent chief, and it created its first board chair role, filled by Harvey Jones. CNBC says Nvidia fell about 13% on the week even as the major indexes had their best week since August, with money rotating into Apple, AMD and Broadcom; one strategist called the Nvidia story idiosyncratic. Reports of an investigation before Huang's exit are unconfirmed allegations, so I rely only on the filing.

stocks.n: 一週約 -13%，11/17 盤後財報；代理執行長 Kress
週內資金輪動的受惠名單之一
同樣被點名為輪動去向

zh: Alphabet 在 10 月底財報後單日大跌，報導說市值一天蒸發約 4,820 億到 5,000 億美元（各家數字不一），原因是搜尋與廣告成長不如預期、AI 模式讓廣告量變少，公司同時把 2026 年資本支出上調到 1,950 億至 2,050 億美元，並說 2027 年可能「顯著增加」。這件事讓市場把問題從「AI 需要多少電」改成「AI 花的錢什麼時候回收」，也是上週 AI 硬體股承壓的背景。市值損失的數字各報導差異很大，請當作量級參考。
en: Alphabet fell sharply in one day after its late-October results; reports put the lost market value between roughly $482 billion and $500 billion depending on the outlet, citing weaker search and ad growth with AI Mode reducing ad volume. It also raised 2026 capex to $195-205 billion and said 2027 could rise significantly. The market question has moved from how much power AI needs to when the spending pays back, which is part of the backdrop to last week's pressure on AI hardware. Loss figures differ widely by source; treat them as magnitude only.

stocks.n: 財報後單日大跌；2026 資本支出 1,950–2,050 億美元
同被點名的雲端資本支出受壓股

zh: 上週五的跨資產數字（單一來源、請當方向參考）：10 年期美債殖利率約 5.15%；黃金約 3,876 美元，跌 0.24%；比特幣約 68,341 美元，跌 4.37%；12 月原油期貨約 89.01 美元，漲 0.30%。布蘭特約 95.84 美元、西德州約 88.56 美元，兩者週跌約 2.5%，美國汽油均價也降到每加侖 4 美元以下。殖利率在 5% 以上，是股市估值最大的壓力；原文把殖利率變動寫成「+1.00%」與「+0.05 個百分點」兩種，我取後者。
en: Friday cross-asset figures (single source, directional only): the 10-year Treasury yield about 5.15%; gold about $3,876, down 0.24%; bitcoin about $68,341, down 4.37%; December crude about $89.01, up 0.30%. Brent near $95.84 and WTI near $88.56 were each down about 2.5% on the week, and the US gasoline average fell below $4 a gallon. A yield above 5% is the biggest pressure on equity valuations; the source gives the yield change as both +1.00% and +0.05 points, and I use the latter.

zh: Tyson Foods（TSN）今天盤前公布會計年度第四季財報。TheStreet 的行事曆預期每股盈餘 0.53 美元、營收 141.0 億美元；另一份預覽給的是約 0.59 至 0.65 美元、營收約 138.8 億美元，兩邊數字不同，請以公司公告為準。市場最在意的是牛肉部門：9 月公司把全年牛肉虧損預期放大，預覽估第四季牛肉虧損約 2.17 億美元；雞肉部門利潤仍強，但價格比去年低，且去年同期基期很高。Tyson 財報後一天的平均波動約 4%。
en: Tyson Foods (TSN) reports fiscal fourth-quarter results before the open today. TheStreet's calendar expects EPS of $0.53 on revenue of $14.10 billion, while another preview cites about $0.59-0.65 and roughly $13.88 billion; the sources differ, so check the release. The focus is beef: in September the company widened its full-year beef loss outlook and a preview estimates a Q4 beef loss near $217 million. Chicken profit is still strong but prices are lower and the prior-year base is high. Tyson's average one-day move after earnings is about 4%.

stocks.n: 今晨盤前財報；牛肉虧損與雞肉價格是焦點
雞肉同業，可對照雞肉價格走勢
肉品同業 Hormel，可對照食品價格

zh: 週二盤前，Home Depot（HD）與 Walt Disney（DIS）同日公布財報。行事曆預期 Home Depot 每股盈餘 3.84 美元、營收 428.1 億美元；Disney 每股盈餘 1.68 美元、營收 251.6 億美元，兩者的分析師評等都偏買進。Home Depot 是看房屋相關消費與利率壓力的窗口：10 年期殖利率在 5% 以上，房貸成本是壓力。Disney 則看串流獲利與樂園客流。這些是預期值，不是結果，數字來自單一行事曆網站。
en: Before Tuesday's open Home Depot (HD) and Walt Disney (DIS) both report. The calendar expects Home Depot EPS of $3.84 on revenue of $42.81 billion and Disney EPS of $1.68 on revenue of $25.16 billion, with analyst ratings skewed to buy. Home Depot is a window on housing-related spending under a 10-year yield above 5%, where mortgage costs are the pressure; Disney is read for streaming profit and park attendance. These are expectations, not results, from a single calendar site.

zh: Nvidia（NVDA）週二盤後公布財報，行事曆預期每股盈餘 2.47 美元、營收 1,088.5 億美元，市值約 4 兆美元。這次的看點不只數字：黃仁勳辭職後第一次財報，市場想聽代理執行長 Kress 怎麼說明接班、出口管制與資料中心需求。CNBC 提到有分析師認為跌深是買點、也有人買進 1 月到期的 200 美元買權，這只是個別意見；Nvidia 目前約在 160 美元附近，我不把它當成建議。
en: Nvidia (NVDA) reports after the close on Tuesday; the calendar expects EPS of $2.47 on revenue of $108.85 billion at a market value near $4 trillion. The numbers are not the only watch point: it is the first report since Huang's exit, and investors want interim CEO Kress on succession, export controls and data-center demand. CNBC cites analysts calling the drop a buying opportunity and a trader buying January $200 calls with the stock near $160; these are individual views, not advice.

zh: Fed 升息的問題不是「會不會」而是「升多少」。Newsquawk 的整理：Fed 在 10 月會議維持利率在 3.75% 至 4.00%，但理事 Cook 與克里夫蘭聯銀總裁 Hammack 投票主張升 1 碼；10 月 PPI 低於預期後，市場傾向 12 月升 1 碼而不是 2 碼，美國銀行預期 12 月、1 月、3 月都會升息。Waller 說如果核心 CPI 約 0.3% 以上，12 月可能要升 2 碼。下一次 FOMC 是 12 月 9 日。
en: The question on Fed hikes is not whether but how much. Newsquawk notes the Fed held at 3.75-4.00% in October, with Governor Cook and Cleveland's Hammack dissenting in favor of a 25 bp hike; after a softer-than-expected October PPI the market leans to 25 bp rather than 50 bp in December, and Bank of America expects hikes in December, January and March. Waller said a half-point hike may be needed if core CPI runs near 0.3% or higher. The next FOMC meeting is December 9.

zh: 10 月 CPI 月增 0.4%（9 月 0.6%），核心 CPI 月增 0.3%，已是連續第三個月；其中食品 +0.5%、能源 +0.7%、運輸服務 +0.8%、二手車 -1.2%。10 月 PPI 月增 0.3%，低於預期的 0.4%，核心 PPI 也是 0.3%。一個特別的限制：去年 10 月資料因政府經費中斷缺漏，所以 CPI 沒有年增率可比。所以市場看的是「月增動能」：核心 CPI 三個月都在 0.3%，是 Fed 不放心的原因。
en: October CPI rose 0.4% on the month (0.6% in September) and core CPI rose 0.3% for a third straight month; food rose 0.5%, energy 0.7%, transportation services 0.8%, used cars fell 1.2%. October PPI rose 0.3%, below the 0.4% consensus, with core PPI also 0.3%. One caveat: October 2025 data are missing after a funding lapse, so there is no year-over-year CPI comparison. The market is therefore reading month-on-month momentum, and core CPI at 0.3% three months running is what keeps the Fed uneasy.

stocks.n: 抗通膨債券 ETF，通膨預期的另一個觀察

原油基金，能源 CPI +0.7% 的來源

zh: 今天的 Fed 看點在談話與地區製造業。紐約聯準銀行總裁 Williams 在 UTC 14:05（台北時間約 22:05）發言，Fed 主席 Warsh 在 UTC 17:00（約 01:00）發言；另外紐約州製造業指數 11 月預期 19.4、10 月是 25.5。這幾個談話放在週三 FOMC 會議紀要之前，市場會找「升多少、升多快」的線索。行事曆網站只列時間，沒有講稿，我不替講話內容下結論。
en: Today's Fed focus is speeches and a regional factory survey. New York Fed President Williams speaks at 14:05 UTC and Chair Warsh at 17:00 UTC, and the Empire State manufacturing index for November is forecast at 19.4 versus 25.5 in October. They come before Wednesday's FOMC minutes, and the market will look for clues on how much and how fast the Fed will hike. The calendar lists only times, not text, so I draw no conclusion about what will be said.

zh: 上週不是「賣科技」，而是「科技內部換位置」：CNBC 說標普 500 的科技類股整週仍漲超過 2%，Nvidia 跌約 13% 的同時，資金轉進 Apple、AMD、Broadcom。換句話說，被賣的是單一公司的治理不確定，而不是整個 AI 主題。不過週五 AI 與晶片股一起收低，也提醒資本支出報酬的疑慮還在（Alphabet 的例子）。看這個板塊，要分「公司風險」和「主題風險」。
en: Last week was not a tech sell-off but a rotation inside tech: CNBC says the S&P 500 tech sector still rose more than 2% on the week, and while Nvidia fell about 13% money moved into Apple, AMD and Broadcom. What was sold was one company's governance uncertainty rather than the AI theme itself. Yet AI and chip stocks closed lower together on Friday, a reminder that doubts about the return on capex remain, as with Alphabet. Separate company risk from theme risk.

被點名的資金輪動去向
半導體 ETF，AI 硬體的整體溫度計

zh: 本週的零售財報密集：Home Depot（週二）、Target、Lowe's、TJX（週三）、Walmart、Ross Stores（週四）。背景有利有弊：美國汽油均價降到每加侖 4 美元以下，是 7 月以來第一次，家庭有多一點可支配現金；但 10 年期殖利率在 5% 以上，房貸與耐久財貸款都貴。這週可以比的是「高價位 vs 平價」：Walmart 與 TJX 代表找便宜的消費者，Home Depot 與 Lowe's 代表房屋相關的大額支出。
en: A dense week of retailers reports: Home Depot (Tuesday), Target, Lowe's and TJX (Wednesday), Walmart and Ross Stores (Thursday). The backdrop cuts both ways: US gasoline fell below $4 a gallon for the first time since July, leaving households a little more cash, but a 10-year yield above 5% keeps mortgages and big-ticket loans expensive. The comparison to make is value versus big-ticket: Walmart and TJX for bargain-seeking shoppers, Home Depot and Lowe's for housing-related spending.

週三盤前，折扣零售代表

zh: 食品與農業鏈今天有兩個觀察點：Tyson 的肉品週期（牛肉虧損、雞肉價格比去年低），以及農產品加工大廠 ADM 的董事 David McAtee II 在 11 月 5 日以每股約 70.27 美元買進 2,800 股、約 19.7 萬美元，目前股價低於他的買進價。這兩件事放在一起，描述的是同一個鏈條的不同端點：上游成本與下游定價誰先反映。內部人買進金額不大，我只當成訊號之一，不是結論。
en: The food and agriculture chain has two reference points today: Tyson's protein cycle (beef losses and chicken prices below last year) and ADM director David McAtee II buying 2,800 shares at about $70.27 on November 5, roughly $197,000, with the stock now below his purchase price. Together they describe different ends of the same chain: whether input costs or downstream pricing adjust first. The purchase is modest, so it is one signal, not a conclusion.

穀物加工同業，農產品鏈對照

en: The Russell 2000 closed Friday at 2,790.49, down 0.31%, slightly better than the S&P 500's -0.40%. One report also says it rebounded on November 6 to about 2,756 after a 4.45% sell-off the day before, so Friday's close sits above that level. Small caps are the most rate-sensitive: with a 10-year yield above 5% and a possible December hike, financing costs bite more directly than for large caps. I did not cross-check that report's dates and figures; treat it as background.

zh: Modular Medical（MODD）上週五收 1.97 美元、單日漲 16.57%，但報導沒有說出明確催化劑，只提到 11 月 9 日的患者調查顯示市場對較簡單的胰島素給藥有興趣。這種「漲幅大、原因薄」的小型股是風險最高的一類：股價低於 2 美元、成交量小、一則消息就能推動價格，也能反向。放進晨報不是推薦，是提醒讀者：看到漲幅榜先問「為什麼漲」，找不到答案就是一種答案。
en: Modular Medical (MODD) closed Friday at $1.97, up 16.57%, but the report names no clear catalyst beyond a November 9 patient survey showing interest in simpler insulin delivery. A big move on thin reasons is the riskiest kind of small cap: a stock under $2 with small volume can be pushed by one headline and just as easily reversed. It is here as a caution, not a pick: when you see a gainers list, ask why first; if you cannot find the reason, that is an answer.

stocks.n: 週五 +16.57% 至 1.97 美元，催化劑不明
胰島素貼片龍頭，可對照產業規模

zh: 工業電氣設備經銷商 Wesco（WCC）的執行副總裁暨財務長 Indraneel Dev 買進 1,725 股、均價約 291.90 美元、金額約 50.4 萬美元，InsiderEdge 的整理顯示近 30 天有 2 位內部人買進；行情顯示這檔當天漲約 8.4%。資料中心與電網建設需要電氣設備，這是這家公司的故事；但整理頁沒有列交易日期，也沒有市值，我無法確認它在小型股還是中型股，只把它放在這裡當作「財務長用自己的錢買」的例子。
en: Wesco (WCC), an electrical and industrial distributor, saw EVP and CFO Indraneel Dev buy 1,725 shares at about $291.90, roughly $504,000; InsiderEdge shows two insiders buying in the past 30 days, and the quote showed the stock up about 8.4%. Data-center and grid build-outs need electrical gear, which is the company's story, but the page lists neither trade dates nor market cap, so I cannot confirm whether it is a small or mid cap; it is here as an example of a CFO buying with their own money.

工業經銷同業，產業對照

zh: 判讀小型股消息，有三件事比大型股更重要：第一，覆蓋的分析師少，一則消息就能讓價格大幅移動，所以來源要多於一個；第二，買賣價差與成交量，同樣一張單子在小型股的衝擊成本更高；第三，同一個「內部人買進」可能是公開市場自掏腰包，也可能是員工持股計畫，後者資訊含量低。今天這份晨報也照這個標準：只有單一來源的數字，我會在卡片上直接註明。
en: Three things matter more when reading small-cap news: few analysts cover them, so one headline can move the price a lot and a claim needs more than one source; bid-ask spreads and volume, since the same order has a larger impact cost; and an insider purchase may be an open-market buy with their own money or an employee stock plan, and the latter carries less information. This brief follows the same standard: figures with a single source are labeled as such on the card.

stocks.n: 小型股的整體基準

en: KORU Medical makes subcutaneous infusion devices. Why it is ignored: revenue is only about $11.6 million a quarter, a thinly covered micro cap. What is changing: Q3 revenue was $11.57 million, up 11.2%; gross margin rose to 65.2% from 60.2%; net income was about $218,000 versus a $778,000 loss; adjusted EBITDA was $1.3 million versus $0.1 million; full-year revenue guidance was revised to $48.0-48.5 million; the source lists 8 open-market purchases and no sales in six months by officers including the COO, CFO and CTO. Risks: cash is only $7.4 million, the source does not show the prior guidance, and the CEO's line is clearly a data error. This is a research lead, not investment advice.

en: Amwell is a telehealth platform. Why it is ignored: telehealth stocks were left behind after the pandemic. Follow-up: Q3 revenue of about $49 million beat its own guidance; the 2026 adjusted EBITDA loss outlook narrowed to about $6.9-7.9 million from $12-16 million; Q4 guidance is revenue of $48-50 million and adjusted EBITDA of $0-1 million, with a goal of positive operating cash flow in Q4. Risks: net loss widened to $11.0 million, about $3.0 million of capitalized software (zero a year ago) flatters EBITDA, and the direct Defense Health Agency contract was described as in its final throes but is not signed. This is a research lead, not investment advice.

en: Eupraxia Pharmaceuticals develops long-acting drug delivery technology; it is clinical-stage with no commercial product. Why it is ignored: small market value, no revenue, and until now no large-broker coverage. Risks: clinical outcomes are binary and a failure could mean a one-day collapse; a target far above the price is not an expected return. This is a research lead, not investment advice.

zh: 判讀政要持股的固定提醒：申報最多可晚 45 天，所以看到的是過去的價位；金額只有寬區間；很多是配偶或信託帳戶執行。另一個細節是「晚報」本身：Disclosed Capitol 整理，眾議員 Michael Rulli 的申報累計 32 筆，其中 22 筆晚於期限，有些交易可追溯到 2024 年 11 月。晚報多不代表有訊息，只代表這一欄的時間資訊比較不可靠。這個頻道只記錄誰申報了什麼，不下動機的判斷。
en: A standing reminder for reading politician disclosures: filings can come up to 45 days after a trade, so prices are from the past; amounts are only wide ranges; and many trades are by spouses or trust accounts. A further detail is lateness itself: Disclosed Capitol says Rep. Michael Rulli has disclosed 32 trades, 22 of them filed past the deadline, some dating back to November 2024. Many late filings do not imply information; they only mean the timing data is less reliable. This channel records who filed what and makes no judgment on motive.

zh: 今天最值得注意的一件事：升息預期、5% 以上的殖利率、領導股換人，三件事同時發生，但上週的三大指數仍然收紅，是 8 月以來最好的一週。原因不是風險消失，而是資金在換位置：從 Nvidia 流向 Apple、AMD、Broadcom，也流向能源。接下來一週有 Warsh 與 Williams 談話、零售銷售、FOMC 紀要、Nvidia 與 Walmart 財報，每一件都可能改變這個結論。想一想：如果 Nvidia 財報沒有讓市場放心，你原本的假設是「個股問題」還是「AI 主題問題」？
en: The one thing worth noting today: hike expectations, a yield above 5% and a leadership change at the AI leader are all happening at once, yet the major indexes still rose last week, the best week since August. Risk did not disappear; money changed places, from Nvidia to Apple, AMD and Broadcom and into energy. This week brings Warsh and Williams, retail sales, the FOMC minutes and Nvidia and Walmart earnings, any of which could change that read. Think: if Nvidia's report does not reassure the market, was your assumption a company problem or an AI-theme problem?
